title: 乡村的变迁
text: 在现代社会中，很多地方发生了巨大的变化。年轻人选择离开家乡，前往大城市寻找机会。他们渴望更好的工作，希望提高生活质量。这种现象导致很多村庄失去了活力。街道上的人越来越少，气氛变得沉闷。原本热闹的场所现在几乎没人光顾。如果政府不采取措施，不然就无法挽回损失。当地的传统文化也面临危机。很多古老的技艺没有继承人。人们必须重视文化保护，不然就彻底消失。教育资源的缺乏也是一个关键问题。学校的学生数量在不断下降。教师们感到压力很大，因为缺乏支持。经济活动的减少影响了整体发展。原本繁荣的贸易逐渐停止。居民们对未来感到迷茫。他们需要新的产业来带动增长。只有创新才能给这里带来希望。这种转变需要长时间的努力。每个人都应该关注家乡的未来。

options: To seek better jobs and a better quality of life

questions.prompt: What is happening to the traditional local skills mentioned in the text?
options: They have no one to inherit them
They are taught in new schools

questions.prompt: Why do the teachers in the village feel great pressure, according to the text?
options: Student numbers are falling and support is lacking
Their pay is lower than in cities
They are being replaced by online education

questions.prompt: What does the text say is needed to bring hope to the declining village?
What does the passage say happened to the once-prosperous trade in the village?

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 越…越…
patterns.explanation: "The more X, the more Y." Pairs two qualities or actions that increase together. The collocation 越来越 (increasingly) is the same structure.
patterns.example_translation: The weather is getting colder and colder.

patterns.title: 如果…就…
patterns.explanation: "If X, then Y." The most common conditional. 如果 can be replaced with 要是 or 假如.
patterns.example_translation: If you have time, come over.
